_comment: GDD §8.1 Magical Crafting - Enchanting Recipes at the Magical Weapon Station

recipes.name: Fire Crystal
recipes.description: Cuts and aligns two Fire Gemstones into a focused fiery magical crystal.

recipes.name: Water Crystal
recipes.description: Distills two Water Gemstones into a crystalline tidal focal point.

recipes.name: Ice Crystal
recipes.description: Fuses two Ice Gemstones into an intensely cold frost crystal.

recipes.name: Earth Crystal
recipes.description: Solidifies two Earth Gemstones into a dense geological conduit crystal.

recipes.name: Nature Crystal
recipes.description: Weaves two Nature Gemstones into a living verdant crystal.

recipes.name: Lightning Crystal
recipes.description: Energizes two Lightning Gemstones into an arcing tempest crystal.

recipes.name: Wind Crystal
recipes.description: Traps soaring gale essence from two Wind Gemstones into a crystalline vortex.

recipes.name: Holy Crystal
recipes.description: Sanctifies two Holy Gemstones into a radiant beacon crystal.

recipes.name: Dark Crystal
recipes.description: Condenses two Dark Gemstones into an abyssal shadow crystal.

recipes.name: Arcane Crystal
recipes.description: Purifies two Arcane Gemstones into a prismatic mana crystal.

recipes.name: Healing Crystal
recipes.description: Bathes two Healing Gemstones into an invigorating restorative crystal.

recipes.name: Fire Staff
recipes.description: Binds a Fire Magical Crystal into a hardwood staff, channeling explosive AoE fireballs that burn targets.

recipes.name: Ice Staff
recipes.description: Binds an Ice Magical Crystal into a hardwood staff, casting piercing frostbolts that slow enemy movement.

recipes.name: Lightning Staff
recipes.description: Binds a Lightning Magical Crystal into a hardwood staff, discharging chain lightning that shocks and interrupts targets.

recipes.name: Holy Staff
recipes.description: Binds a Holy Magical Crystal into a hardwood staff, smiting enemies with radiant light while emitting healing pulses to nearby allies.

recipes.name: Dark Staff
recipes.description: Binds a Dark Magical Crystal into a hardwood staff, unleashing shadowy bolts that curse targets to reduce their damage.

recipes.name: Arcane Staff
recipes.description: Binds an Arcane Magical Crystal into a hardwood staff, hurling pure mana bolts that siphon energy back to the caster.

recipes.name: Healing Staff
recipes.description: Binds a Healing Magical Crystal into a hardwood staff, granting dedicated combat healing support for party members.
